algorithm: For each public state SHA and selected action, record current episode own original observed action count, observed novel successor count, self-loop count, and successor visits. Any untried action at same state must be explored first. Tie rotates from public SHA first byte modulo seven. Once all seven tried, score 4*new successor count -3*own repeated state-action count -2*self loop count -min(2, successor visits). No stage objective; no manual route or hidden pose, no other actor knowledge, no reward oracle. Underlying native original selected feedback still updated exactly once.
controls: Unmodified Go DK11 & Ygg R15 selected-action stage-free parents; conventional independently implemented same public novelty algorithm and same FIT; independent random and frozen R16 no-online-learning; source original env.step for all roles.
result_rule: Both new native candidates must each execute at least 3 distinct original actions per original episode and at least one real original goal reward across three new source worlds. Else negative. Even positive is engineering only.
authority: All draft/unmerged, no accepted model/controller/G29/proxy/science first-use.
